newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bock interested in Lonrho trading interests - paper.
newsitem.headline: Bock interested in Lonrho trading interests - paper.

text.p: Dieter Bock, former chief of British mining and trading firm Lonrho Plc, is interested in buying a stake in its African trading activities following demerger, a German newspaper said on Monday.

The Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung said Bock thought such an acquisition more likely if the trading unit were sold outright rather than as a demerger in which South African mining firm Anglo American would retain its 28 percent stake.
"The question would then be, where would I get my stake," he was quoted as saying. It was not clear whether Anglo would be ready to sell its stake to him, he added.
Anglo upped its stake in Lonrho to 28 percent from 10 percent by purchasing shares originally held by Bock.
No target date for the demerger has yet been set.
